extracted.name: Homemade Freezer Waffles Recipe
extracted.description: These convenient freezer waffles are perfect to make ahead and enjoy golden, crispy waffles ready to go all week long. They're crisp on the outside and light and fluffy inside.
ingredient_lines: 6 Tablespoons vegetable oil (, avocado oil or melted coconut oil)
instruction_lines: Dry Ingredients: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Wet Ingredients: In a separate bowl mix milk, oil, egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Combine dry ingredients into wet and set aside.
Beat Egg Whites: In another clean bowl, beat the egg whites with a hand mixer until soft peaks form. Gently fold the beaten egg whites into the batter.

Cook: Grease hot waffle iron and use about a scant ¼ cup of batter per waffle-- cook until just lightly golden (cook a little less than you would normally for eating, if you plan to freeze them, and re-toast them later).
Cool on a wire rack to keep the bottoms from getting soggy.
Freeze: Add cooled waffles to a freezer safe bag or container and freeze up to 6 months.

To Reheat: place in toaster until warmed, or air fryer at 350 degrees for 2-3 minutes. You could also rewarm all at the same time in the oven, placing waffles directly on oven rack and cook at 350 degrees for 5 minutes.
